Physical Security Findings: Bypass Methodology for Pin-Tumbler Padlock on Screw-Mounted Hasp
Overview

The following document outlines a non-destructive bypass methodology for the pin-tumbler padlock on a screw-mounted hasp, as depicted in the site-survey capture. This methodology is intended for practitioner-level guidance to ensure auditors can follow the procedure on-site.

Tools Required
Lock Pick Set: Including a tension wrench and various pick tools.
Magnifying Glass: For detailed inspection of the lock mechanism.
Flashlight: To illuminate the lock cylinder for better visibility.
Step-by-Step Bypass Procedure

Initial Inspection

Tool: Magnifying Glass
Contact Point: Lock cylinder
Movement: Inspect the keyway for any visible obstructions or signs of wear. Look for any visible pins or shear lines.

Apply Tension

Tool: Tension Wrench
Contact Point: Keyway
